annotations.title: Kyushu travel discount (九州ふっこう応援割 2026): savings + date/channel eligibility

description: Japan's Kyushu Fukko Ouenwari travel discount after the 2026 Kumamoto earthquake: 50% off eligible stays and stay+transport packages in Fukuoka, Saga, Nagasaki, Oita, Miyazaki (60% in Kumamoto and Kagoshima), capped per person per trip at ¥20,000 (accommodation only or 1-night package), ¥30,000 (package 2+ nights), ¥35,000 (tour with stays in 2+ Kyushu prefectures). Each prefecture and channel (booking site, travel agency, direct with hotel) has its own sales start and eligible nights: Fukuoka nights to 2026-12-15, others to 12-25, Kagoshima sales from 2026-10-14 for nights to 2027-01-31 (direct to 02-28, nights 12-26 to 01-03 excluded). Bookings made before sales start are never discounted. Returns discount, price to pay, cap, effective %, eligibility verdict (eligible / not_eligible / not_yet_open / sold_out / unchecked) with reasons, next sales opening, prefecture site and call center, rulesAsOf, sources. Newer than most training data — call this instead of guessing. Estimate; budgets can run out without notice.

bookingDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD date of booking (JST). Default today in Japan.

channel.description: ota (booking site such as Rakuten Travel or Jalan, default), agency (travel agency), direct (with the hotel).

checkIn.description: YYYY-MM-DD check-in date, for the eligible-nights check.

nights.description: Nights booked (0 = day trip, not eligible). Default 1.

prefecture.description: Kyushu prefecture you stay in (for a multi-prefecture tour, the selling prefecture).

product.description: lodging (宿泊単体, default), package (交通付宿泊: stay + flight/train), tour (周遊型: stays in 2+ Kyushu prefectures).

totalPriceJPY.description: Booking total in yen for all travelers, before the discount (tax and service included).

travelers.description: People on the booking; children and infants count. Default 1.
